purpose: Report-only register of the firms that hold the desk's withdrawable money. Read by desks/mt5/research/counterparty_register.py. Not an allocator input until a principal wires it; nothing here sizes a trade.
no_account_identifiers: This file names firms and account LABELS only. It never carries an account number, login or server login; the reader drops any login-shaped key it meets.

p_default_prior.unit: probability the firm fails to pay a requested, eligible withdrawal within one year (annual hazard, converted to a per-day hazard as -ln(1-p)/365)
p_default_prior.basis: Judgement prior, NOT a measurement. No default-rate dataset for prop firms or retail CFD brokers is held. Values are ordered by the public trust evidence below (regulator, review grade, recent rule churn, restriction events) and are meant to be overridden with --p-default FIRM=VALUE.

rationale.E8 Markets: Unregulated prop evaluation firm; TrustPilot profile restricted 2026-08-22 and PropFirmMap safety grade cut A+ to D on 2026-08-23 (trust 2.9/10); payout count and size capped by the E8 Zero terms. Prior set high on purpose.
rationale.FTMO: Unregulated prop evaluation firm with the longest public payout record of the three; A+ grade, 4.8 on about 54k reviews. Rule rewrites in April 2026 are churn, not a default signal.
rationale.Fusion Markets: ASIC-regulated broker (Pty Ltd); client money is the client's own balance, not a discretionary payout. 24/7 withdrawals since 2026-06-05.
